project_type: Next.js 14 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS finance/news site for a US audience
build_system: npm (Node v22 via nvm). Node is NOT on PATH by default in this sandbox.
test_framework: None. No unit test framework is configured. Verification is `npm run build` + `npm run lint`.
verification_instructions: 1) Source nvm: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"  2) Run `npm run lint` (must show 'No ESLint warnings or errors')  3) Run `npm run build` (must exit 0; note it runs next-sitemap postbuild). Both currently PASS on the baseline and must stay passing.
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/sitemap.xml is generated by next-sitemap during `npm run build` postbuild. Do not hand-edit it. It regenerates on every build.
setup_instructions: Dependencies are already installed in node_modules. Source nvm before running npm. No .env is required — the site falls back to sample data when Sanity env vars are absent (lib/sanity.ts sets isSanityConfigured=false).
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET. Remote images from picsum.photos are allowed at runtime, but MUST be whitelisted in next.config.js images.remotePatterns or next/image will throw. Do NOT push and do NOT open a PR — leave commits on local main with a clean working tree.
contribution_requirements: Must respect the 'Ink & Oxblood' design language: warm paper bg, hairlines not shadows, sharp corners (radius clamped 0-2px; rounded-full ONLY for avatars), single oxblood accent used sparingly (<~5% of screen), tabular-nums for data, eyebrow labels, newspaper column rules, thin-stroke line icons (components/icons/LineIcon.tsx), NO emoji, NO teal/amber/bright signal colors, NO hover lift. Keep: CryptoTicker live behaviour, news-before-calculators homepage order, dark mode, mobile responsiveness, accessibility (meaningful alt text on every image), newsletter staying UI-only, market-data disclaimer. All images must have meaningful alt text.
key_patterns: Data model: `data/sample-news.ts` exports sampleArticles (ArticleCard[]), sampleFullArticles (Record), sampleCategories, and helper getters. Types live in `lib/sanity-queries.ts` — ArticleCard and Article both already have an optional `mainImage?: SanityImage`, but sample data does not populate it and components render a `.thumb-duotone` placeholder plate instead of a real . `lib/sanity-queries.ts` is the data access layer; it returns sample data when isSanityConfigured is false (the current runtime state). `lib/category-styles.ts` exports getCategoryTone(slug) -> { label, rule }. Reusable CSS utilities live in app/globals.css @layer components: container-page, container-prose, section-padding, hairline-t/-b/-y, eyebrow, eyebrow-accent, eyebrow-strong, accent-rule, section-header, section-title, page-title, panel, panel-flush, panel-muted, panel-hover, rule-grid (+ rule-grid-surface), rule-cell-hover, btn-primary, btn-secondary, link-accent, link-quiet, title-link, field-label, field-input, field-error, data-table, data-figure, thumb-duotone. CategoryBadge renders eyebrow + 2px rule (no pill). NewsletterSignup is a client component, purely UI-only. IMPORTANT: the news listing (app/news/page.tsx), category page (app/news/category/[category]/page.tsx) and article detail (app/news/[slug]/page.tsx) still use the OLD design language (rounded-full pills, rounded-lg, mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 py-12) and grey placeholder divs — they should be brought in line with the new utilities while adding images.

directory_structure: app/ = App Router pages (news/, calculators/, bank-routing-numbers/, legal pages, page.tsx home, layout.tsx, globals.css). components/ = home/ (CryptoTicker, FeaturedArticle, MarketDataWidget, TrustSignals, NewsletterSignup), news/ (ArticleCard, CategoryBadge, PortableTextRenderer), banks/, calculators/, icons/LineIcon.tsx, Header.tsx, Footer.tsx, ThemeProvider.tsx. config/site.ts = nav + footer + social. data/ = sample-news.ts + banks.ts. lib/ = sanity-queries.ts (data access + types), sanity.ts, category-styles.ts, schema-markup.ts. public/ = generated sitemap.xml. next.config.js = Next config (images formats only, no remotePatterns yet).
